text:
رکھا سکھا کھا کے، ٹھڈا پاݨی پی،
نہ ویکھ پرائیاں چوپڑیاں، نہ ترسائے جی۔
romanized:
Rukkhā sukkhā khā ke, ṭhaḍḍā pāṇī pī,
Na vekh parāīāṅ choprīāṅ, na tarsāe jī.
literal_en:
Eat your dry bread and drink cold water.
Do not look at other's buttered bread, nor make your heart thirsty.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
